title: The Grateful Hatchling
prompt:

CHARACTER BIBLE:
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs
Pets (draw these the same way on every page):
- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size

The baby dragon has just been freed from tangled forest vines.

The dragon happily nuzzles against them
as the children gently hug the small dragon.

One child laughs while the other pets the dragon's head.

Winnie stands nearby wagging excitedly.

Broken vines lie on the ground.
